content: {"summary":"Customers repeatedly report losing phones in Uber rides and cannot contact drivers or report the loss due to two‑factor authentication that requires a code from the lost device, causing missed flights and delayed recovery. The lack of a phone‑free reporting channel frustrates users, especially when drivers are unresponsive or unreachable, leading to extended wait times and no live support. Many users have tried social media or email with no response, compounding the issue. Uber must provide an alternative verification method and a dedicated support line for lost‑item cases. "}
